description: Display Genre icon and map/wireset counters in AdminCP Genre list
find:
<xf:main href="{{ link('char-edit/genre/edit', $genre) }}">
                                <xf:label>{$genre.title}</xf:label>
                                <xf:hint>{$genre.class}</xf:hint>
                            </xf:main>
                            <xf:cell class="dataList-cell--min dataList-cell--hint" title="{{ phrase('cv6_setting_count') }}" data-xf-init="tooltip">
                                {$genre.setting_count|number}
                            </xf:cell>
replace:
<xf:cell class="dataList-cell--min dataList-cell--iconic">
                                <xf:if is="$genre.icon">
                                    <xf:fa icon="{{ cv6icon($genre.icon) }}" />
                                <xf:else />
                                    <xf:fa icon="fa-tags" class="u-muted" />
                                </xf:if>
                            </xf:cell>
                            <xf:main href="{{ link('char-edit/genre/edit', $genre) }}">
                                <xf:label>{$genre.title}</xf:label>
                                <xf:hint>{$genre.class}</xf:hint>
                            </xf:main>
                            <xf:cell class="dataList-cell--min dataList-cell--hint" title="{{ phrase('cv6_setting_count') }}" data-xf-init="tooltip">
                                <xf:fa icon="fa-book" class="u-muted" /> {$genre.setting_count|number}
                            </xf:cell>
                            <xf:if is="is_addon_active('cv6/BattleMaps')">
                                <xf:cell class="dataList-cell--min dataList-cell--hint" title="{{ phrase('cv6_rpg_battlemap_count') }}" data-xf-init="tooltip">
                                    <xf:fa icon="fa-map" class="u-muted" /> {$genre.map_count|number}
                                </xf:cell>
                            </xf:if>
                            <xf:if is="is_addon_active('cv6/DiceRoller')">
                                <xf:cell class="dataList-cell--min dataList-cell--hint" title="{{ phrase('cv6_rpg_wireset_count') }}" data-xf-init="tooltip">
                                    <xf:fa icon="fa-dice-d20" class="u-muted" /> {$genre.wireset_count|number}
                                </xf:cell>
                            </xf:if>
